beats: Have you eaten? You've looked at that Office door all shift.
Eat? With the Bureau after me? Waiting tables, I can't keep up.
I owe them too. We'll be buried with those cards half stamped.
Then bury me somewhere I can sit down.
You'd get up to look at that door. Is it so handsome?
Who says? Did Okafor say something? Who else has he told?
He said nothing, you goose. You just did.
Yes, I'm seeing him. If the Office hears, it costs us both.
Not from me, they won't. Stop looking, though. You can't afford it.
Bureau loan, behind, could be cleared. Okafor, Office door, could be used.
learned: Debt: Bureau loan, and she's behind.
Secret: seeing Okafor, the door guard.
opens: Pressure: threaten to expose the affair.

beats: I've paid part of your Bureau loan, Miss Nikolaou.
Wrong girl, mister. Have it sent back before the terrace sees.
It's stamped at the Bureau now. It doesn't come back.
Who's been asking about me? What's it going to cost?
Nothing today. Later, one small thing that hurts nobody.
Thank you, then. But I can't do anything for it yet.
We can wait. I'll be back with the rest.
learned: Inez took it. Not ready yet.

beats: That's the rest paid. You owe the Bureau nothing, Miss Nikolaou.
Not so loud. I've owed them since my last good shoes.
Then buy shoes first, Miss Nikolaou. We'll wait our turn.
Thank you, I mean that. Your turn. What do I owe?
A few minutes. When I telephone, call Okafor off the Office door.
Okafor. You know about us, then. What happens to him?
Easy, now. Nothing, if this goes right. And he never sees us.
You did bring the rest. I'll say it won't go by telephone.
I'm with you. I watch that square anyway. Trouble, I'll warn you.
learned: Loan paid. Inez is with us.

beats: Is it the Bureau? I know I'm behind.
Not the Bureau. Softly. The Office could learn about you and Okafor.
All right. Yes. Whatever it is, yes. Just not the Office.
Hear it first. When I telephone, you call Okafor off the door.
He'd come. I'd say it can't go by telephone.
Keep Okafor with you a few minutes. That's all we ask.
You're very polite about it. Go, before someone sees you.
I know what this is. Not a word of us to Okafor.
learned: Threatened, she agreed; knows Fixer's face.

beats: You said money, and it's been a lean month. For what, exactly?
We've paid already. One short drive with the Councillor.
I won't ask who's we. Driving the Councillor's never paid like that.
At the chime he gets in. Not home, the service bay.
East yard, round the back. And I wait how long, exactly?
Until we've got him. Not long.
Been paid for 'not long' before. Couple of minutes, then I drive.
A couple of minutes, Zhou. We'll be at the service bay.
I won't look. Anyone watching the service bay, I can send off.
learned: Zhou waits a couple of minutes.

beats: It's time, Miss Nikolaou. Call Okafor across now. You'll do fine.
Now? With the terrace looking? Yes. All right.
Long. This door's said nothing all day. It's good to hear you.
Come across. I've something to tell you, and not down a telephone.
I've this door till shift's end. For you, it can wait.
Walk, love. Don't run. Let me keep you a while.
Keep me as long as you like.
opens: Camera blind? Then enter the Office.
